description:
Your Macro Shimano

THE FASTEST ADVENTURE HARDTAIL IN THE WORLD – WITH CONFIGURABLE SRAM BUILD OPTIONS

The MASON Macro combines the capability to carry bikepacking gear across variable off-road terrain with the imperative to keep moving at racing speed – as demonstrated by Angus Young's record-breaking ride of the Eastern Divide Trail.

Build a lightweight, flat bar, fully rigid bikepacking machine or combine the Macro with a suspension fork to enhance comfort, control and momentum on extended, fast, multi-terrain adventures with more challenging trail conditions.

The Macro is highly configurable, conceived around bikepacking loads, accessory attachment and fluid-carrying capacity from the outset. It is designed for customisation, allowing the rider to fine tune a configuration that matches their requirements and planned adventures.

Select an optimum load and bottle formation from 28 eyelets ranged over 8 mounting points. Maximise space for front-mounted loads with integrated cable routing that minimises bar clutter, choose conventional internal routing if you prefer, or use a combination of both to tune the Macro exactly to your requirements.

Transform the Macro for diverse terrain by switching seamlessly between MASON’s own load-carrying carbon fibre HotShoe2 fork or 100-120mm of suspension, with geometry corrected to work efficiently in either mode. This flexibility even extends as far as switching from a flat bar format to drop bars. The Macro is as truly adaptable as you are.

The Macro's commitment to progressive details and innovation continues into the dropouts, where the inclusion of a UDH (Universal Derailleur Hanger) ensures compatibility with the latest drivetrain conventions.

RideDrivenDesign

The Macro has been tested in the world’s toughest environments. The Eastern Divide Trail, Silk Road Mountain Race, Accursed Race, Atlas Mountain Race and the Arizona Trail have already established the Macro as vital equipment for MASON riders Becky Surridge, Ella Brown, Josh Ibbett and Angus Young, as they take on the extreme environments of ultra endurance races.

Away from the racing scene, the light weight and configurability of the Macro create an ideal platform for bikepacking. Multiple mounting points and careful details give unrivalled options for carrying gear – whether you’re equipping for a lightweight overnighter or an extended tour.

Mason X Dedacciai custom formed and shaped aluminium frame

Geometry tuned for ultra adventure racing and bikepacking

Configurable cable routing options, including integrated and internal options for unobstructed mounting of essential frame bags

Cataforesi anti-corrosion treated, inside and outside of frame tubes, before acrylic primer, topcoat and 2 tough clearcoats.

Optional accessories include 3D-printed chainstay protector and Voilé gear straps

MASON HotShoe2 fork, with side accessory-mounting points, and options for integral MASON Shutter load-bearing fender or MASON Condenser rack

28 eyelets in 8 accessory attachment locations across frame and rigid fork, maximising adaptability and versatility

29” wheel size, with clearance for 2.4” tyres

Option to fit a suspension fork without a change in geometry. Optimised for 100mm, maximum 120mm
